summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K to announce an agreement with Sprott Mining Inc. to terminate the remaining obligation under the Silver Delivery Agreement. Under the terms, 592,000 ounces of silver delivery obligations will be extinguished in exchange for 7,956,696 common shares of Americas issued at a deemed price of US$5.57 per share. The termination eliminates over $45 million in variable future debt obligations. The share issuance is subject to TSX approval and will have a four-month hold period. This is a bespoke recapitalization/contract termination, not a standard special-situation category.
